problems.title: Find missing number
problems.description:
Given an array containing n distinct integers taken from the range [0, n], find the one number that is missing from the array.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of elements in the array.
Line 2: n distinct integers.

Output Format:
Return the missing integer.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000
All elements are distinct and each is in the range [0, n].

visibleTestCases.explanation: The numbers from 0 to 5 are present except 3.
The numbers from 0 to 3 are present except 2.
The only missing number from 0 to 1 is 0.

problems.title: Maximum Consecutive Ones
problems.description:
Given a binary array containing only 0s and 1s, find the maximum number of consecutive 1s.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of elements.
Line 2: n binary integers.

Output Format:
Return the length of the longest consecutive sequence of 1s.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000
Each element is either 0 or 1.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The longest consecutive run of 1s has length 3.
The longest consecutive run of 1s has length 2.
There are no 1s in the array.

problems.title: Find the number that appears once, and other numbers twice
problems.description:
Given an array of integers where exactly one integer appears once and every other integer appears exactly twice, find and return the integer that appears once.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of elements. n is odd.
Line 2: n integers.

Output Format:
Return the integer that appears exactly once.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100001
Exactly one value appears once; every other value appears exactly twice.

visibleTestCases.explanation: 1 appears once, while every other number appears twice.
All values except 9 occur exactly twice.
